message: Changing the description of the FileFlag parameter (#96)

pr.title: Changing the description of the FileFlag parameter
pr.body: Changing the description of the FileFlag parameter to a more understandable one.

diff:
diff --git a/aconfig.go b/aconfig.go
index 4c1d060..3eef7eb 100644
--- a/aconfig.go
+++ b/aconfig.go
@@ -72,7 +72,8 @@ type Config struct {
 	// Easy wat to cobine base.yaml with prod.yaml
 	MergeFiles bool
 
-	// FileFlag to make easier pass file with a config via flags.
+	// FileFlag the name of the flag that defines the path to the configuration file passed through the CLI.
+	// (To make it easier to transfer the config file via flags.)
 	FileFlag string
 
 	// Files from which config should be loaded.

explanation.what: Config.FileFlag フィールドの godoc コメントを、より説明的な内容に書き換えた。「FileFlag to make easier pass file with a config via flags.」から「FileFlag the name of the flag that defines the path to the configuration file passed through the CLI.」に変更し、括弧書きで補足を追加した。
explanation.why: PR body に "Changing the description of the FileFlag parameter to a more understandable one." とある通り、既存コメントが分かりにくかったための言い回し改善。コードの挙動変更は無い。
